newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan extends deadline for loan defaulters.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan extends deadline for loan defaulters.

text.p: Pakistan's central bank said on Friday that a deadline for loan defaulters to reach agreements with their creditors had been extended to September 5 from July 5.
A committee headed by State Bank of Pakistan Governor Muhammad Yaqub said there would be no further extensions. It did not extend a December 5 deadline for repayments to be completed.
The SBP had offered incentives to defaulters on June 5 aimed at recovering bad loans worth an estimated 127 billion rupees.
It had asked defaulters to agree on repayment schedules with their creditors by July 5, saying it expected some 8,100 loan defaulters to use of the scheme to clear their arrears.
The committee decided to prepare legal cases against defaulters before September 5, so that immediate action could be taken against them when the new deadline expires.
